name: chapters-json
summary: Parse a podcast:chapters JSON file, repairing the one real-world corruption that breaks JSON.parse on otherwise intact chapters, without ever rewriting a valid file.
caveats: Returns unknown. It parses, it does not validate: check for a chapters array of { startTime, title } yourself.
The chapters URL comes from a feed, so fetch it on a server with the safe-feed-fetch recipe and read it with readCappedText.

Repairs exactly one corruption (an orphan run of digits between a comma and the next quote, outside any string). Anything else throws the original SyntaxError. Do not widen it: the input is bytes a stranger chose.
